findings.title: Unclear specification of site facilities
findings.message: The short and long text list "Bauzaun, Baustromverteiler, Bauwasseranschluss, Container und Verkehrssicherung nach RSA 21" without any quantitative or technical details (e.g., fence height, power capacity, container size, required safety measures). This violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which requires clear and exhaustive descriptions.
findings.suggestion: Specify fence height and mesh, power distribution capacity (kW), water connection size, container dimensions and type, and exact RSA 21 requirements.

findings.title: Missing dimensions for hand‑opened slots
findings.message: The description "Schlitze bis 1,20 m Tiefe vorsichtig öffnen, Leitungen sichern und wieder verfüllen" does not define slot width, length or protection measures, making the scope ambiguous (VOB/A § 7).
findings.suggestion: Add required slot width (e.g., 0.30 m) and length, and state protective measures for adjacent utilities.

findings.title: Use of vague term "ca." and unclear storage method
findings.message: The phrase "ca. 30 cm dick, seitlich mieten" is imprecise; VOB/A demands exact dimensions and clear description of the side‑storage method. The soil class is also missing, which is required by STLB‑Bau standards.
findings.suggestion: State exact thickness (e.g., 30 cm) and define the side‑storage location, method and soil class (e.g., Humus‑rich, class A).

findings.title: Missing technical data for trench reinforcement
findings.message: The description "Verbauplatten und Steifen bis 2,50 m Grabentiefe fachgerecht einbauen und rückbauen" lacks type, dimensions, spacing and material class of the plates and steifs, which are mandatory under VOB/C § 4.2 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Specify plate size, material grade (e.g., steel S235JR), spacing, and any required anchoring.

findings.title: Incomplete technical data for prefabricated concrete manhole
findings.message: Only the standard (DIN V 4034‑1) and nominal diameter are given. Required details such as overall height, wall thickness, reinforcement class and access fittings are missing, which are required by the STLB‑Bau standard text.
findings.suggestion: Add overall dimensions, wall thickness, reinforcement details and required accessories (e.g., cover, gaskets).

findings.title: Missing reinforcement and dimensional data for strip foundations
findings.message: The entry "Streifenfundamente aus Stahlbeton C25/30 XC2" does not state foundation width, depth, reinforcement layout or required tolerances, violating VOB/A § 7 and the STLB‑Bau requirement for complete technical specifications.
findings.suggestion: Provide foundation width, depth, reinforcement bar size, spacing and concrete placement tolerances.

findings.title: Lack of reinforcement details for the ground slab
findings.message: Only concrete class and thickness are given. Required reinforcement type, mesh size and placement are missing, which are essential for compliance with DIN EN 206 and VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Add reinforcement details (e.g., B500B mesh, 12 mm bar spacing).

findings.title: Price‑adjustment clause for bitumen binders and diesel fuel
findings.message: The pre‑contractual note "Preisgleitklausel für bituminöse Bindemittel und Dieselkraftstoff nach Stoffpreisgleitklausel‑Richtlinie vereinbart" shifts price risk entirely to the contractor and may be deemed unreasonable under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Limit the price‑adjustment to a reasonable index and include a cap to avoid disproportionate burden on the contractor.
